```{r}
# load your results and raw sample
results <- read_excel("Example_Data_For_Dev/qPCR_IAV_matrix_20241115_results.xls", sheet = "Results")

raw_sample <- loadWorkbook(file = "Example_Data_For_Dev/Raw_sample_20241212.xlsx")
addWorksheet(raw_sample, "Results")
writeData(raw_sample, "Results", results)
saveWorkbook(raw_sample, "Example_Data_For_Dev/Raw_sample_20241212_edited.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE) 

```
